content: Public keyless ATS JSON feeds: Greenhouse GET api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board}/jobs?content=true (all jobs, no pagination); Lever GET api.lever.co/v0/postings/{company}?mode=json (supports team/location/commitment filters); Ashby GET api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{org}?includeCompensation=true. No OAuth needed; each posting has stable ATS-native id + updated/created timestamps. Cross-checked cavuno, fantastic.jobs, official Greenhouse dev docs listing.
